limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Original specification defines binary select behavior; no additional unknown-select requirements were assumed.
No synthesis or board work performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation uses a one-bit combinational selection: sel=0 selects a, sel=1 selects b. No revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent oracle uses explicit if/else and tests all eight binary input combinations plus four repeated select transitions. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(a,b,sel,out), all ports one bit; combinational with no added ports or latency.
static_review: Complete continuous assignment; no state, latches, reset, or pipeline.
